name: component-contract-props
goal: Component contracts call arguments props and omit the function return output section

steps.title: Identify the failing behavior, expected behavior, and reproduction.
steps.evidence: The component Contract view currently shares callable labels: the generated EntityHeader screenshot shows its framework-state list as a contract row. Expected component contracts label declared inputs as Props and omit output/return groups; function contracts retain Parameters and Returns.

steps.title: Explain why existing standardized tests missed the bug; name the scenario, fixture, lifecycle or assertion gap and reusable test change.
steps.evidence: The standardized component Contract browser test already visits OrderList's selected revision, but only asserted that States is absent. It never asserted field-section semantics. Extend that reusable real-browser scenario using its shared fixture (orders and searchText props plus markup return), capture the same contract state, and assert Props is present while Inputs and Outputs are absent. Current main also omits the stale States row; this request concerns the remaining generic component headings.

steps.title: Strengthen the existing standardized test; commit it before repair, run it failing with loop record --phase red, and preserve the assertion.
Implement the smallest repair without weakening the regression test.
Rerun the same unchanged regression test at a separate fix commit with loop record --phase green; preserve passing proof.
Run relevant project checks and affected UI browser flows with fresh inspected screenshots and no unexpected browser errors; preserve diagnostics and keep pending until proof passes.
